name: react-email
description: Teaches coding agents how to build HTML emails with React Email components, add the visual editor, render to HTML, and send with Resend.

interface.shortDescription: Build HTML emails with React Email components
interface.longDescription:
React Email is a modern, component-based toolkit for building HTML emails that work across major clients. This plugin installs the React Email agent skill already maintained in this repository.

Use it when building or changing email templates with React components, adding the React Email visual editor to an app, rendering emails to HTML, sending with Resend, or implementing patterns like welcome emails, password resets, notifications, order confirmations, and newsletters. The skill covers components, Tailwind styling, i18n, sending, and the embeddable editor — with deeper references loaded on demand.
defaultPrompt: Build a welcome email with React Email and Tailwind
Create a password reset email template
Add the React Email visual editor to my React app
